主要内容: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. entered into a collaboration and license agreement with Kite Pharma, Inc., a subsidiary of Gilead Sciences, Inc., to research, develop, and commercialize engineered cell therapies for cancer. Under the agreement, Sangamo will design zinc finger nucleases (ZFNs) and adeno-associated viruses (AAVs) to modify T cells and NK cells, including inserting genes for chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), T-cell receptors (TCRs), and NK cell receptors (NKRs). Kite will handle clinical development and commercialization. The agreement is subject to antitrust waiting periods and other closing conditions. Sangamo will grant K, an exclusive, royalty-bearing, worldwide license under its patents and know-how. Additionally, Sangamo received an upfront payment of $150 million and is eligible for milestone payments up to $3.01 billion. Kite will assume operational and financial responsibility for development, manufacturing, and commercialization. Sangamo will also receive royalties based on future sales, subject to reductions due to patent expiration or biosimilar competition. Kite has the right to terminate the agreement for any reason after a notice period or due to bankruptcy or material breach. The full agreement will be filed as an exhibit to Sangamo’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ending March 31, 2018.
